patterns: which courses are offered in the college
could you please provide me with a complete list of all the departments and programs available at sdit
response: SDIT offers the following departments: B.E in Computer Science & Engineering (CSE), CSE (Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning), Information Science & Engineering (ISE), Artificial Intelligence & Data Science (AI&DS), Electronics & Communication Engineering (ECE), Mechanical Engineering (ME), Civil Engineering (CE), and Aeronautical Engineering. Postgraduate: M.Tech in Construction Technology, Master of Business Administration (MBA), Master of Computer Applications (MCA), and a Research Centre for PhD.

patterns: tell me about the cse department
what does the cse department offer
i want to know everything about the computer science and engineering department at sdit
response: The Department of Computer Science and Engineering (CSE) was established in 2006 and offers a 4-year B.E degree. With world-class training and research, the department encourages students to take part in sponsored research projects through industry-institute collaboration. Lab facilities include Data Structure Lab, OOPS Lab, Electronics Circuits & Logic Design Lab, Microprocessor Lab, Operating Systems Lab, Computer Networking Lab, Algorithms Lab, DBMS Lab, System Programming Lab, and Internet Programming Lab.

tell me about the artificial intelligence and machine learning program offered under cse
response: The Department of CSE (Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning) was established to meet the increasing demand for computer professionals. It offers a 4-year B.E degree in CSE (AI & ML) with world-class training, research opportunities, and state-of-the-art facilities. The program covers machine learning algorithms, deep learning, natural language processing, and AI applications.

patterns: tell me about the ise department

response: The Information Science & Engineering department enables connectivity of data across the globe, catering to domains requiring large data-intensive applications. It offers an eight-semester B.E degree as per VTU syllabus. Students are encouraged to visit IT exhibitions, participate in industry-sponsored seminars and conferences, and interact with industry representatives.

response: The Department of Mechanical Engineering applies principles of physics and materials science for analysis, design, manufacturing, and maintenance of mechanical systems. It is backed by well-developed laboratories including CAED Lab and CAMD Lab with state-of-the-art hardware and software, preparing students for diverse areas including designing and analyzing manufacturing plants, industrial equipment, robotics, medical devices, and more.

response: The Department of Civil Engineering emphasises quality education requiring a broad understanding of scientific principles, knowledge of materials, and the art of analysis and synthesis, along with research, teamwork, leadership, and business skills. Lab facilities include Basic Material Testing Lab, Surveying Practice Lab, Hydraulic Lab, CAD Lab, Environment Engineering Lab, and Geo-Tech Lab.

response: The Department of Electronics & Communication Engineering imparts quality education to help students find openings in the Telecommunication and Computer industry. The B.E degree is affiliated to VTU. Lab facilities include Analog Electronics Lab, Logic Design Lab, Microcontrollers Lab, DSP Lab, VLSI Lab, and Power Electronics Lab.

patterns: tell me about the aeronautical department

response: The Aeronautical Engineering department covers aircraft design, stability and control of aerospace vehicles, propulsion systems, low and high speed aerodynamics, and development of advanced technologies in defence and space science. Experienced faculty provide individual attention, and the department has adopted Project-Based Learning so students can apply creative problem-solving skills to real-world problems.

patterns: tell me about the mca department

response: The Master of Computer Applications (MCA) program at SDIT is a two-year full-time course that includes interactive classes, national seminars, and outbound activities. It emphasizes practical experience through projects and internships. Graduates are prepared for careers in software development, IT consulting, and systems analysis. PGCET Code: C476.

response: The MBA program at SDIT focuses on managerial aspects of accounting, finance, marketing, and management, with case studies and industrial visits incorporated into the syllabus. It equips students with practical skills, offering dual specialisations in areas like Marketing, Finance, and HR, preparing them for managerial positions in small businesses as well as multinational companies. PGCET Code: B281.

patterns: tell me about the be programs at sdit
response: SDIT offers 4-year B.E (Bachelor of Engineering) programs in 8 branches: Computer Science & Engineering (CSE), CSE (AI & ML), Information Science & Engineering (ISE), Artificial Intelligence & Data Science (AI&DS), Electronics & Communication Engineering (ECE), Mechanical Engineering (ME), Civil Engineering (CE), and Aeronautical Engineering. Eligibility: minimum 45% aggregate in Physics, Chemistry & Mathematics at PUC level (40% for SC/ST/OBC). CET Code: E146.
